newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Thai Danu Bank to set US$150 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Thai Danu Bank to set US$150 mln FRCD.

text.p: Thai Danu Bank has mandated DBS Bank and Societe Generale Asia to arrange a US$150 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue, bankers said on Wednesday.
Tranche A of US$100 million has a final maturity of five years with a put and a call option in year three. It pays a coupon of 60 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is in the "low 80s", bankers said.
Tranche B of US$50 million issue has a final maturity of five years with annual put options. It pays a coupon of 40 basis points.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is in the "low 50s", the bankers said.
An arranger group is being formed.
